## Checklist

- [ ] New or changed rules are `"status": "draft"` — a reviewer other than me verifies
- [ ] Every value has a citation: document, page, box, verbatim `original_text`
- [ ] No value from memory; verified rules superseded, never edited
- [ ] One rule per file, one file per commit
- [ ] `pnpm rules:validate` and `pnpm test` pass locally
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
